21zf:
The innovative Bachelor of Architecture (Honours) in Architecture course aims to nurture creative design leaders who flourish in architectural practice, with first-rate communication and management skills, as well as multidisciplinary knowledge and abilities. It aims to produce exceptional architects through an education that is immersed in hands-on experiences.

Architects are involved in the planning and design of the buildings and spaces people inhabit. Architecture is everywhere and brings together many fields of human endeavor, including art, history, physics, engineering, and more.

The Architecture undergraduate program is an innovative course founded on Loughborough University's 100 years of 'theory and practice' culture to foster learning in both the university and the workplace. The Architecture program will allow students to study with allied courses in the School and wider University to mimic real-life work scenarios. More specifically, the program exploits Loughborough University's internationally-renowned expertise across the built environment disciplines, including construction, engineering, and building energy. A significant part of the program is studio-based, supported by a dedicated team of architectural practitioners.

Every year, Loughborough University holds an End of Year Show to celebrate the year’s achievements and showcase student work to practitioners interested in hiring students and graduates.
21z6:
The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Accounting and Financial Management course is designed to prepare students for careers in diverse areas of accounting, finance and management and to equip them to deal with the challenges of an ever-changing business world. One of the key goals of the Accounting and Financial Management program is to develop the wider skills and intellectual independence that graduates will need to thrive in a long, rewarding professional career. This course offers students the opportunity to study a much wider range of subjects than those of the narrow professional syllabuses.

The course develops skills valued by employers including independent learning and research, analytical skills, teamwork, presentation skills, project work, computer skills and numeracy. Lectures are supported by online resources, tutorials, workshops, seminars and discussion groups. The wide variety of optional modules allows students to develop specialist skills and tailor their degree to suit their career aspirations.

Skills for employability is a key part of the Loughborough University experience and can really boost students' job prospects and this program has a module specifically built in to help students develop their study and employability skills. There are also specific modules in entrepreneurship to help those with aspirations to start or develop their own businesses.
22bb:
The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Commercial Management and Quantity Surveying program is linked to real-life construction problems, allowing students to develop important professional skills such as analytical thinking, teamwork, presenting, project management and report writing. These will enable them to pursue a career as a professional Commercial Manager, Quantity Surveyor, or another specialist career path.

To meet the needs of tomorrow’s Commercial Managers and Quantity Surveyors, this course is sponsored by the Loughborough Construction Consortium. These companies offer sponsorship, work placements and graduate jobs for students, and enable practical experience in the form of site visits and guest speakers.

The course has achieved dual accreditation by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) and the Chartered Institution of Civil Engineering Surveyors (CICES).

This course comes with the option to work in industry for a year on an approved placement, leading to a Diploma in Industrial Studies (DIS). Students may be able to study abroad for a year, resulting in an additional Diploma in International Studies.
222m:
In today's business world, being international is a necessity. Loughborough's Bachelor of Science (Honours) in International Business is a modern-day business course which concentrates on the links between the major business functions and their role in the international business context. By covering the key management disciplines from a global perspective, students will be equipped for a successful career in a range of business and management roles. Students also have access to an exclusive set of international business modules, plus the chance to develop their language skills.

In the first year of this program, students will be introduced to the major business functions as well as the financial, economic, organizational and international environments that managers and organizations must operate within. In the second year, students will further their study in the international business context and examine how managerial issues vary around the globe. Students will also have the option to undertake an ‘International Semester’, which is a 6-month study abroad scheme. There is also the opportunity to integrate an International Semester into the second year of study, as well as opportunities for students to enhance their language skills in German, French, Spanish and Mandarin.

In the final year of the program students will have the opportunity to build on their experiences on placement or studying abroad. Students will be able to tailor their degree and choose more advanced optional modules that suit their career ambitions. Among others, these include an exclusive set of international business modules, and a wide range of options in management, finance, marketing, operations, analytics, human resource management, and new business development.

Skills for employability is a key part of the Loughborough University's experience and can really boost students' job prospects and this degree has a module specifically built in to help students develop their study and employability skills. There are also specific modules in entrepreneurship to help those with aspirations to start or develop their own businesses.
222u:
The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Marketing and Management combines a rigorous in-depth knowledge of marketing, together with a solid grounding in business and management to prepare students for a wide range of exciting and rewarding career opportunities. Students will develop highly prized specialist skills in digital marketing, consumer behavior and global brand management, plus essential business and management skills in areas such strategy and leadership.

In the first year of the program, students will build a firm foundation for modules in subsequent years by studying core business and management subjects. In the second year, students will start to develop an in-depth understanding of marketing by attending specialized modules such as marketing research, consumer behavior, global brand management, and digital marketing. They will also be able to choose from a wider range of business options. For those with interest in retailing careers, Loughborough University’s renowned expertise and corporate connections in these areas means we offer a stream of retailing modules that enable students to tailor their degree to suit their career ambitions. Following the professional placement or study abroad year, the final year provides advanced specialized core modules on marketing strategy and planning, and marketing communications, along with a broad range of optional modules in many areas of marketing and management.

The program will also help students to develop their communication and interpersonal skills and their ability to work in groups, essential for working in fast-paced marketing and management roles. Skills for employability is a key part of the Loughborough University experience and can really boost students' job prospects. This program has two modules specifically built in to help them develop their study and employability skills. There are also specific modules in entrepreneurship to help those with aspirations to start or develop their own businesses.
2238:
Loughborough University's Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Mathematics provides a balanced study of the most important aspects of mathematics so that students can achieve a thorough understanding of the fundamentals to help prepare them for a successful career.

Mathematics is an exciting subject which is not only fascinating to study in its own right but also underpins a great variety of endeavors such as science, commerce and industry. A mathematics degree is actively sought by employers and opens many doors to subsequent employment and further study. Its study gives students the numerical abilities, logical thinking and analytical skills that are crucial to the success of diverse organizations within commerce, banking and finance, management an industry. Through innovative teaching the department equips its students with these skills while also opening up the many facets of this rich and stimulating discipline.

Over the first two years of the program students will study the core aspects of mathematics, including analysis, linear algebra, geometry, probability and statistics, complex variables, mechanics and calculus of variations. In the final year students will undertake an individual project or report, and choose from wide-ranging options spanning pure and applied mathematics, enabling them to tailor the course to their particular interests.
223j:
Loughborough University's exciting Bachelor of Science in Media and Communication takes a multidisciplinary approach to the study of media and communication. Students will acquire a thorough understanding of both historical and contemporary developments across a number of key media sectors including the press, broadcasting, film, advertising and digital media.

On the Media and Communication degree, students will gain a wide range of specialist analytical and practical skills relevant to many jobs that involve working with the media and communication industries. The broad scope of the course is designed to enable students to work in a range of different fields of communication and media, and adapt flexibly to a rapidly changing environment where critical understanding and analytical skills are of key importance.

22ub:
Loughborough University's Master of Arts/Master of Science in Design Innovation programme will help students engage with design and innovation as drivers for change in organisations, generating insight from across the creative and strategic domains.

They will learn from the most influential thought leaders, pioneering researchers and creative innovators, who will expose them to the latest theories and developments in the field.

They will have access to the latest knowledge, debates and issues in design and innovation, enhancing their creative, strategic and collaboration skills through a mixture of active learning and project work.

Each module will develop their design innovation knowledge by analysing and evaluating current practices, issues and debates and provide them with the opportunity to respond to genuine industry challenges.

The inspiring learning environment will encourage them to think creatively and improve their effectiveness as a professional in the fields of design, innovation and strategy.
22ur:
Digital media and creative industries are a fast-growing sector, opening new and exciting career opportunities for those with the right combination of knowledge and skills. By undertaking Loughborough University's Digital Media and Creative Industries Master of Arts students will be equipped with cutting-edge skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in the digital and creative economy.

In today’s increasingly digital and interconnected landscape, creativity is a driving force behind global economies. As the world becomes more digitally connected, there is growing demand for individuals with diverse skill sets and innovative minds. The Digital Media and Creative Industries Master's programme is designed to equip graduates with the expertise to be at the forefront of this fast-paced, creative, and ever-evolving industry.

This programme offers the perfect blend of theory and hands-on experience empowering students to curate their own specializations within the digital media and creative industries. The programme is highly flexible, offering customized pathways which focus on promotional cultures and industries, digital media industries, and creative industries.

The core modules are designed to cultivate student's conceptual and contextual understanding of developments in digital media and the creative industries. They will have the opportunity to explore a range of topics from digital platforms and network society and culture, through to cultural policies and the creative economy. In optional modules they can fine-tune their skills and shape their expertise. From advertising and creative campaigning to harnessing the power of digital media applications, preserving digital heritage, exploring cultural institutions, and delving into social identities and media, they will engage with the latest cutting-edge research and developments in the field of media and creative industries.
225p:
Loughborough University's Construction Management Master of Science programme enjoys a great heritage, being the longest established in the United Kingdom and the second oldest in the world. The programme is continually evolving to equip graduates with the core skills needed to succeed as a construction professional and provides the widest possible range of module options, allowing students to pursue individual interests within the construction management field.

Construction projects have become more complex in our changing world, where there are increasing concerns regarding sustainability and social value. The Construction Management program is suitable for those who wish to combine project management expertise with more managerial business expertise. The programme offers the most flexible module selection compared to other construction programmes.

The School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering is one of four Royal Academy of Engineering Centres of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, and one of the most highly funded built environment groups by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC).
225q:
Loughborough University has been teaching construction at postgraduate level longer than any other university in the United Kingdom. The Construction Project Management Master of Science programme delivers core technical project management expertise while providing a holistic perspective of the construction project processes and the challenge of project management in complex building and infrastructure projects.

Competency in project management has become a crucial skill set of all construction professionals and executives, with many construction project managers functioning in a strategic and coordinating role in the delivery of the client’s physical development and investment programme. This program is designed to further develop these competencies and advance students' career within the construction industry.

The School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering is one of four Royal Academy of Engineering Centres of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, and one of the most highly funded built environment groups by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC).
2276:
The Master of Science in Construction Project Management with Sustainability is uniquely dedicated to developing construction managers’ knowledge and expertise in sustainable practices, focusing on the integration of sustainable design and construction processes across a building life cycle.

Managing construction has become inexorably intertwined with sustainability. The requirement for construction managers to have expertise in environmental engineering, building physics, sustainable design, and the commissioning and testing of sustainable buildings is fundamental to practical decision-making and professional judgements.

This programme addresses critical global challenges by integrating contemporary construction management theory and practice with fundamental and interrelated sustainable design and construction. Students will benefit from hands-on experience and knowledge to deepen their expertise for application within the public or private sector.

The School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering is one of four Royal Academy of Engineering Centres of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, and one of the most highly funded built environment groups by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC). The School hosts the Building and Industrial Services Pipework Academy (BISPA), which is a collaboration with global steel manufacturer Tata Steel and the Chartered Institution of Building Services Engineers (CIBSE). This uniquely holistic view of construction makes it best placed for developing graduates that meet the increasing demands of the sector.
226f:
The Full-Time Master of Business Administration (MBA) course is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge to become an elite performer in business, accelerate their career and maximize business performance in a global environment.

At Loughborough University, with their long heritage and unrivalled reputation for sport, they understand the mindset needed to go from being a high achiever to an elite performer.

If students are professional with at least three years’ professional/managerial experience, the AMBA (Association of MBAs) -accredited Full-Time MBA can take them on a transformational journey that will enable them to fulfil their potential and realise their professional ambitions.

Loughborough University supports students in developing the intellectual, analytical, personal and enterprise knowledge, skills and behaviours to become an effective, globally-minded, socially responsible leader. The Loughborough University MBA equips students with a robust grounding in how to manage complex organisational issues, devise creative solutions to real business challenges, get the most out of a team and how to lead and manage change in demanding, global markets.
4mzv:
Program Description

Loughborough's Full-Time MBA degree is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge to become an elite performer in business, accelerate their careers, and equip them to maximise business performance in a global environment.

At Loughborough University, with their long heritage and unrivaled reputation for sport, they understand the mind-set needed to go from being a high-achiever to an elite performer. The school's focus is on guiding students through a transformational experience that will enable them to fulfill their potential. Loughborough's internationally recognised full-time MBA degree will teach students to: manage complex challenges, from exporting to new markets to getting the most out of their team; problem solve creative solutions for real business challenges; and lead innovative change to capitalise on opportunities.

Learning alongside an international cohort of experienced managers with a minimum of 3-years’ professional/managerial experience will enable students to share fresh perspectives on similar problems and build lasting business networks. Students will also have opportunities to meet and work with the department's Executive MBA students on some modules.
